executiveSummary.headline: Reconcile Event and Dining Inventories While Protecting Strong AI Presence
executiveSummary.lead: The St. Regis Mexico City has strong measured presence—71.9% AI Consideration, 91.7% Scenario Presence, and the second position among six certified Marriott Bonvoy peers. The priority is not broad awareness; it is source-of-truth precision where official event-room and dining frames differ, plus clearer representation of verified assets that remain weak in the certified attribute read.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration is the share of comparable monitored answers mentioning the hotel; Scenario Presence is the share of eligible traveler-need scenarios where it appeared. Certified Peer Position uses the named governed peer set. These measures do not represent bookings, ADR, revenue, or traveler exposure.
